mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, user_id AS userId, total_amount AS totalAmount, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, product_price AS productPrice, quantity, amount, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_no, user_id, total_amount, status ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status} )

INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, product_id, product_name, product_price, quantity, amount ) VALUES
( #{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.amount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
